name: Volumetric Spot Noise Rendering
aliases: Volumetric Spot Noise for Procedural 3D Shell Texture Synthesis
definition: A rendering technique that represents volumetric structures (like grass or smoke) as a collection of oriented, scaled primitives (impulses) stored in a texture, rendered via accumulation blending to approximate volume density and color.
summary: Volumetric Spot Noise Rendering synthesizes procedural 3D shell textures by projecting random impulses as Gaussian kernels, using a hybrid pipeline to avoid sorting artifacts and popping.
